summary: WS summary exposed explicit session state, transcript count, outbound send preview, and inbound match facts.
Replay failure diagnostics exposed stepIndex/lastSeq plus partial-step evidence instead of a generic timeout only.
Transcript collection stayed bounded and artifact-first; full transcript remains a local path reference when saved.
diagnostics: Unsafe regex matcher was rejected with a stable websocket-specific error code instead of attempting a broad regex wait.
Replay failure returned a bounded failing stepIndex, lastSeq, partialSteps, and partialTranscript payload for recovery.
Inputs remained explicit: sessionId, websocket URL, outbound text, bounded matcher.

notes: This phase-1 primitive remains internal-first and must not be described as a public browser websocket fuzz tool.
The capability is session/transcript evidence only; it does not infer state machines or orchestrate whole-site websocket discovery.
Replay failure handling remains bounded and diagnostic-first; the agent should continue from the explicit failing step instead of doing hidden retries.
